The ensembleThe ensemble.

The core ensemble

Flute · Executive Director

Guillermo Laporta

Guillermo Laporta is a Spanish flutist, composer, and designer based in New York City, co-founder and Artistic Director of CreArtBox and of Festival ADAR.

Full biography →Website →Contact →
Piano · Co-Director

Josefina Urraca

Josefina Urraca is a Spanish pianist and co-director of CreArtBox and the Festival ADAR. Her playing has been praised by Mundo Clásico for its blend of "introspection and musical abandon" - a balance between precision and emotional risk that defines her work both on stage and behind it.

Full biography →Website →Contact →
Violin

Emilie-Anne Gendron

Lauded by The Strad for her "marvelous and lyrical playing," NYC- based violinist Emilie-Anne Gendron appears with Orpheus, Momenta Quartet, Toomai Quintet, Musicians from Marlboro, Orchestra of St. Luke's, The Knights, Talea Ensemble, A Far Cry and Gamut Bach Ensemble, among others.

Full biography → Website → Instagram
Viola

Matthew Cohen

Ukrainian-American violist Matthew Cohen is a dynamic and versatile artist whose captivating performances have made him one of the most sought-after violists of his generation. He was a special prize winner at the prestigious Primrose International Viola Competition.

Full biography →Website → Website → Instagram
Cello

Julia Yang

Praised for "her sense of joyful virtuosity" as concerto soloist (South Florida Classical Review), Julia Yang is a courageous and soulful cellist, multi-faceted performer, and founding member of the Naumburg-winning Merz Trio and of the clarinet-cello-piano ensemble Trio Phōs.

Full biography → Website → Instagram

A 501(c)(3) non-profit chamber music ensemble. Creating and producing live art performances that fuse classical and contemporary music with visual art and design. New York · Asturias.
